step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features Route 53 routing traffic through AWS WAF to CloudFront. CloudFront directs requests either directly to an S3 bucket for static content or to a custom EC2 load balancer (Pass Secure). The load balancer routes requests into an Amazon EKS cluster hosting the Magento e-commerce stack. EKS integrates with several backend services: OpenSearch (ElasticSearch) for search indexing, ElastiCache for caching/session management, an EC2 instance for NFS, S3 for logs and media, and Amazon Aurora (MySQL) as the main database. At the bottom, standalone operational/supporting components include VPN, Lambda, Amazon Redshift, and an EC2 mail server.
